shove.definition:
n. the act of shoving (giving a push to someone or something)
v. push roughly
shove.translation:
n. 推, 挤
vt. 推挤, 猛推, 强使
vi. 推

shove-halfpenny.definition: n a game in which coins or discs are slid by hand across a board toward a mark

shoved.translation: v. 推, 猛推, 乱推( shove的过去式和过去分词 ); 乱放; 随便放; 胡乱丢

shovel.definition:
n. a hand tool for lifting loose material; consists of a curved container or scoop and a handle
n. the quantity a shovel can hold
n. a fire iron consisting of a small shovel used to scoop coals or ashes in a fireplace
v. dig with or as if with a shovel
shovel.translation:
n. 铲, 铁铲
v. 铲

shovel-nosed.definition:
a. Having a broad, flat nose; as, the shovel-nosed duck,
   or shoveler.

shovel-shaped incisor.translation: [医] 铲形切牙, 铲形门齿

shovelboard.definition:
n. A board on which a game is played, by pushing or
   driving pieces of metal or money to reach certain marks; also, the game
   itself. Called also shuffleboard, shoveboard, shovegroat, shovelpenny.
n. A game played on board ship in which the aim is to
   shove or drive with a cue wooden disks into divisions chalked on the
   deck; -- called also shuffleboard.

shoveled.definition: v dig with or as if with a shovel
shoveled.translation: vt. 铲, 铲出（shovel的过去式与过去分词形式）

shoveler.definition:
n. a worker who shovels
n. freshwater duck of the northern hemisphere having a broad flat bill
shoveler.translation: n. 用铲者, 挖土机驾驶员

shovelers.definition:
plural of shoveler
n. a worker who shovels
n. freshwater duck of the northern hemisphere having a broad flat bill
shovelers.translation: (shoveler 的复数) n. 用铲者, 挖土机驾驶员

shovelful.definition: n the quantity a shovel can hold
shovelful.translation: n. 满铲, 一铲的量

shovelfuls.translation: n. 一铲之量( shovelful的名词复数 )

shovelhead.definition: n. small harmless hammerhead having a spade-shaped head; abundant in bays and estuaries

shoveling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Shovel
shoveling.translation:
n. 铁铲；一铲的量；铲车
vt. 铲除；用铲挖；把…胡乱塞入
vi. 铲

shovell.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 肖维尔职业名称, 铲子制造者或销售者, 来源于中世纪英语, 含义是“铲子”(shovel)

shovelled.translation: v. 铲子( shovel的过去式和过去分词 ); 锹; 推土机、挖土机等的)铲; 铲形部份

shoveller.definition:
n a worker who shovels
n freshwater duck of the northern hemisphere having a broad flat bill
shoveller.translation: n. 用铲者, 挖土机驾驶员

shovelling.translation: v. 铲子( shovel的现在分词 ); 锹; 推土机、挖土机等的)铲; 铲形部份

shovellings.translation: (shovelling 的复数) v. 铲子( shovel的现在分词 ); 锹; 推土机、挖土机等的)铲; 铲形部份

shovells.translation: (shovell 的复数)  [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 肖维尔职业名称, 铲子制造者或销售者, 来源于中世纪英语, 含义是“铲子”(shovel)

shovelnose.definition:
n. The common sand shark. See under Snad.
n. A small California shark (Heptranchias maculatus),
   which is taken for its oil.
n. A Pacific Ocean shark (Hexanchus corinus).
n. A ganoid fish of the Sturgeon family (Scaphirhynchus
   platyrhynchus) of the Mississippi and Ohio rivers; -- called also white
   sturgeon.

shovels.definition:
n a hand tool for lifting loose material; consists of a curved container or scoop and a handle
n the quantity a shovel can hold
n a fire iron consisting of a small shovel used to scoop coals or ashes in a fireplace
n a machine for excavating
v dig with or as if with a shovel
shovels.translation:
n. 铲子( shovel的名词复数 ); 锹; 推土机、挖土机等的)铲; 铲形部份
v. 铲子( shovel的第三人称单数 ); 锹; 推土机、挖土机等的)铲; 铲形部份

shoves.definition:
n the act of shoving (giving a push to someone or something)
v come into rough contact with while moving
v push roughly
v press or force
shoves.translation: v. 推, 猛推, 乱推( shove的第三人称单数 ); 乱放; 随便放; 胡乱丢

shoving.definition:
v come into rough contact with while moving
v push roughly
v press or force
shoving.translation: v. 推开, 挤浆（shove的ing形式）
